description: This file defines API route handlers for managing recipes in a backend application using FastAPI. It includes endpoints to list, create, retrieve, update, and delete recipes, converting database models to API schemas and coordinating with a repository layer.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI's router class for defining API route groups.

classes.name: RecipeRepository
classes.description: Repository class for database operations related to recipes.

methods.name: RecipeOut to_recipe_out(model: RecipeModel)
methods.description: Converts a Recipe ORM model to a RecipeOut schema, transforming ingredients and tags fields.

methods.name: List[RecipeOut] list_recipes( skip: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Number of items to skip"), limit: int = Query(100, ge=1, le=1000, description="Maximum number of items to return"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list recipes with pagination.

methods.name: RecipeOut create_recipe( payload: RecipeCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new recipe.

methods.name: RecipeOut get_recipe( id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="Recipe ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a recipe by id.

methods.name: RecipeOut update_recipe( payload: RecipeUpdate, id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="Recipe ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing recipe.

methods.name: None delete_recipe( id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="Recipe ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete a recipe by id.
